ValidationRule.description: Ensures that users cannot populate Total Cost Override unless Service provided by is selected. This maintains data integrity by requiring key healthcare cost details before overriding total cost.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
$Setup.Data_Migration_Check__c.Bypass_Flow_Validations__c = FALSE && ISBLANK(Source_System_ID__c) &&
AND( RecordType.Name = "Hospitalization", ISBLANK( Service_Provided_by_Facility__c ), NOT( ISNULL (Total_Cost_Override__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select Service Provided by Facility to populate Total Cost Override.
